name: Let's Mahj RVA
description: Studio at Stony Point Fashion Park (South Richmond). Own site quote: "We play by National Mah Jongg League rules and keep score throughout the session." Also Mahj 101 and Guided Play classes ("We'll introduce you to the tiles, the National Mah Jongg League card, and the flow of the game in a relaxed, encouraging environment."). Club sessions are 8-week blocks ($130) or monthly membership ($45-$69); class dates are booked through the group's scheduler.
schedule: Club sessions: Tue 11:00am-1:00pm (all levels); Tue 6:30-8:30pm (advanced); Wed 6:30-8:30pm (all levels); Thu 11:00am-1:00pm (advanced). Mahj 101 $60 weekday daytime / $70 evenings and weekends.
